He served as a reminder of the importance of faith and obedience to Allah, even in the face of adversity. In Islamic communities, the name Imran can be given as a tribute to this important figure in Islamic history.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Imran lies in its meaning as a 'beloved son' or 'comforting friend.' It is a reminder of the love and affection that parents have for their children. At the same time, it can also signify the comfort and solace that a true friend can provide in times of need. Additionally, for those named Imran, the name can serve as a reminder of their role as a beloved child of Allah and as a consoling friend to others. It calls them to live up to these qualities and be a source of love, comfort, and strength in their community.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidāyah wa l-Nihāyah, under 'Yemen and its kings'. Imram ibn Mudrik is mentioned as the king of Yemen during the time of the Prophet Solomon (as). He is known for his great wealth and power, and for his hospitality to Solomon, who visits him and is impressed by his kingdom.

Al-Tabari's Tarikh al-Rusul wa l-Muluk, under 'The Arab tribes before the rise of Islam'. Imram ibn Faris is mentioned as the king of Yemen who conquered Saba' and Hadramaut. He is also known for his patronage of scholars and poets.

In literature and poetry, 'Imram' can refer to a poetic work or a character who exemplifies spiritual growth through a long and arduous journey. In video games, 'Imram' can be the name of a legendary sea explorer, a powerful character, or a quest with a significant spiritual component.
